Introduction
This 
 document describes the regular maintenance that has to be done for HRSG 
 T.I.( Temperature 
 indicator) and the interval of each item of 
 maintenance
The first draft is initiated by eng. Hany elokda, tested by eng. Bahaa abd 
 elwahab, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
 eng. Mohamed el sherif, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPCo. 
 quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of 
 Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
 sector
Manufacture | Quantity | Tag Numbers | Model | Range | Instrument 
 type | Service Description
Winters | 8 | TI(116,783,...etc) | R24452002S-C-TAG | 0-650 C | Temperature indictor | Steam
Winters | 8 | TI(432,403,...etc) | T52120B34-S-TAG | 0-300 C | Temperature indictor | Water
Ashcroft | 4 | TI(001D,002D,...etc) | 50EI60R090 | 0-300 C | Temperature indictor | Detractor storage tank water
Winters | 12 | TI(001,004,065,...etc) | T52120B33-S-TAG | 0-200 C | Temperature indictor | Water
Ashcroft | 4 | TI (003B, ... etc) | 50EI60R060 | 0-150C | Temperature indictor | Blow down tank water
Winters | 20 | TI(162,100,603,741,918,...etc) | T52120B35-S-TAG | 0-450C | Temperature indictor | Steam and water
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, 
 Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope 
 around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Heater
Blower & Brushes
Cleaning fluids such as Freon - TF, 
 chlorothene.
Work to be 
carried out
Inspection and 
maintenance of P.I.
Make calibration procedures to the Temperature Indicator.
Indicator Cleaning.
Close the work permit.
